subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` index arbitrary JSONL/raw message logs, or should that workflow live in QMD/session-memory or a ClawHub memory plugin?
rationale: Current main deliberately admits Markdown plus gated multimodal files, while raw message logs create security and retention questions that need maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Document/plugin route
options.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD/session-memory or a ClawHub JSONL memory plugin as the supported path.

options.title: Add guarded builtin JSONL
options.body: Accept native JSONL in builtin memory only with parser, line mapping, watcher, memory_get, docs, and sensitive-data tests in one reviewed change.

options.title: Extend plugin API first
options.body: Open a narrower plugin API design item if current memory plugin surfaces cannot support a JSONL recall plugin cleanly.

recommendation.title: Document/plugin route
recommendation.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD/session-memory or a ClawHub JSONL memory plugin as the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the prior keep-open review and has recent memory docs/package-source history.
